Folks, we need to talk about the brutal realities facing our working-class communities and marginalized neighborhoods every single day under this relentless crisis of gun violence. The proposed legislation from the 2026 State of the State agenda is nothing more than a bare minimum response to a systemic failure. 

For far too long, corporate manufacturers have prioritized their bottom lines over human lives, flooding our streets with weaponry designed for mass carnage that can be easily converted into illegal machine guns. While the measure requiring guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified and establishing criminal penalties for these conversions is necessary to rein in corporate recklessness, it is ultimately just a Band-Aid on a deeply wounded, profit-driven system that fundamentally fails to protect vulnerable populations. 

True public safety will never be achieved through piecemeal regulations alone. It demands a radical institutional overhaul, holding powerful manufacturers fully accountable for the bloodshed they enable, and dismantling the systemic inequalities that breed violence in the first place.
